method.name: count
method.shortdesc: Displays the number of elements in the Topic.

parameter.name: name
parameter.shortdesc: The name of the topic. Note: This is the text that appears in the index.

parameter.name: sortBy
parameter.shortdesc: The string to sort this topic by instead of the topic name. Note: The actual topic text, rather than the sort order text, appears in the index. (Optional)

parameter.name: withProperties
parameter.shortdesc: Initial values for properties of the new Topic (Optional)

method.name: item
method.shortdesc: Returns the Topic with the specified index or name.

parameter.name: index
parameter.shortdesc: The index or name. Can accept: Long Integer or String.

method.name: itemByName
method.shortdesc: Returns the Topic with the specified name.

method.name: itemByRange
method.shortdesc: Returns the Topics within the specified range.

parameter.name: from
parameter.shortdesc: The Topic, index, or name at the beginning of the range. Can accept: Topic, Long Integer or String.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The Topic, index, or name at the end of the range. Can accept: Topic, Long Integer or String.

method.name: firstItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the first Topic in the collection.

method.name: lastItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the last Topic in the collection.

method.name: middleItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the middle Topic in the collection.

method.name: previousItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the Topic with the index previous to the specified index.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The index of the Topic that follows the desired Topic.

method.name: nextItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the Topic whose index follows the specified Topic in the collection.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The Topic whose index comes before the desired Topic.

method.name: anyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns any Topic in the collection.

method.name: everyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns every Topic in the collection.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the Topic.
Returns the Topic with the specified index.

property.name: length
property.shortdesc: The number of objects in the collection.
